persons.name: Devaśaṃkara
persons.evidence: dvija śrīdevaśaṃkaraṇa (!), thva ṣaḍaṃśāstra (!) coya dhunakā dina

notes: The catalogue records the scribe as Bhavāniśaṃkara, but the colophon text reads dvija śrīdevaśaṃkaraṇa. A subsequent note dated NS 902 records the death of Lakṣmīpati and the sati of Lakṣmīśvarī; this later record has been excluded as it does not concern the copying of the manuscript.
